description: One page of an airport's arrivals on record for one airport-local day, landed and cancelled flights included (coverage on_record: the flights GADUIN has a record of, not the airport's full schedule). Each physical flight appears once with its codeshares, ordered by scheduled arrival (unknown schedules last), with origin, scheduled departure, scheduled, estimated and recorded arrival in UTC, status and a link to its flight page. The recorded arrival is a landing as the airport shows it, never an estimate. Each flight belongs to exactly one date: the airport-local date of its scheduled arrival, whenever it actually landed (with no scheduled arrival, the date of its recorded landing), so days add up without double counting. While next_cursor is not null, call again with the same airport and cursor set to it to read the rest of the day.

airport.description: Airport IATA code (e.g. LHR) or ICAO code (e.g. EGLL). An IATA code works for airports with a page on gaduin.com; otherwise give the ICAO code.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous answer, to read the next page; give the same airport (and date, if given) with it. Omit for the first page.

date.description: Airport-local date YYYY-MM-DD, within the last 400 days. Defaults to the airport's today.

limit.description: Max flights per page (1-500). Defaults to 100.

name: get_airport_arrivals
title: Airport arrivals board
